name: EPIC 212734516
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 17, 5.8 solar radii and 1.11 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,055 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 1.11 solar masses and 5.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,001 K at its surface.
